name: Starfire Barrage casts seven damage-free flurry arrows when it hits
contract: Starfire Barrage 802682 follows its hit with seven visual-only arrows of the Rapid Fire arrow spell 993772,
which ApplyContracts reduces to a dummy effect on one enemy target. They start from the Barrage hit handler, so
they only fly when Barrage landed, and they must not add damage of their own.
Expected: one landed Barrage is followed by exactly seven casts of 993772, and 993772 deals no damage.
